review_scope: Only closure of the same-body formal/free-variable static slot collision; product and tests were read, not edited.
revision_note: The implementation was present as working-tree changes at review time; file SHA256 values identify the reviewed content.

checks.name: local_free_variable_slot_semantics
checks.conclusion: cell_slot denotes this body co_freevars interface slot, not an outer binding origin or runtime cell identity.

checks.name: same_body_static_slot_disjointness
checks.conclusion: The validator resolves each layout to its own environment and rejects intersection of formal slots and captured free-variable slots with function_entry_slot. Record validation already restricts non-null cell_slot to CAPTURED_CELL.

checks.name: no_alias_or_order_regression_in_rule
checks.conclusion: The new check compares static slot IDs only. It does not compare actual object identities, reference targets, locations, or entry position. A formal promoted to this body co_cellvars remains legal because that is not this body captured free-variable interface. Existing independent logical/physical order and repeated actual-reference/coarse-location tests remain present.

checks.name: minimal_collision_regression
checks.conclusion: Regression changes only a formal slot to the captured free-variable slot while retaining distinct entry ValueIDs; it requires precisely function_entry_slot and rejects dumps at the codec boundary.

existing_component_gate.evidence_use: Read existing gate report; this review did not rerun the gate.

does_not_prove: A declared cell_slot or formal slot actually matches source symtable, co_freevars, co_cellvars, or a runtime callable; extraction/source/code replay remain separate obligations.
Automatic full body entry recovery, actual Python signature binding, or correctness of closures/defaults/builtins extraction.
Actual object/cell/location disjointness, complete effects, purity, content identity, lifetime/release, or transformation authority.
Completion of all M1 or whole-program modeling requirements; this closes one structural consistency defect only.
